hero.title: Software that fits your reality.
hero.subtitle: Built with care, delivered on time.
hero.description: We work with teams that need IT consulting done right. We listen to your context, prioritize quality in every decision, and propose solutions that actually solve the problem — not the ones that look best on a slide.

services.title: What we do
services.subtitle: Three areas where we can help your team, with the same standard of work across all of them.

cloud.title: Cloud infrastructure
cloud.description: We design and operate cloud environments that are reliable, maintainable, and sized to your actual needs — not over-engineered.

platforms.title: Platforms & digital products
platforms.description: MVPs, internal platforms, and digital products built with your team, not for them. From idea to production, with a focus on what users actually need.

software.title: Custom software
software.description: Code that's readable, tested, and built to be maintained by your team after we hand it over.

solutions.title: How we typically engage
solutions.subtitle: Two common ways teams work with us. We adapt the scope and pace to your reality, not the other way around.

migration.title: Cloud migration
migration.description: Moving systems to the cloud without disrupting your users. We plan the cutover with you, not for you.

development.title: Project development
development.description: We join your team for the duration of a project, with clear scope, honest timelines, and code your developers will want to inherit.

values.title: How we work
values.description: Four principles we hold ourselves to on every project. They're not slogans — they're the criteria we use when we say yes, when we push back, and when we recommend a different path.

commitment.title: We take commitments seriously
commitment.description: What we promise is what we deliver. If something isn't going to work, we'd rather tell you now than hand you something you're not happy with.

quality.title: Quality first
quality.description: We'd rather deliver less than promised than more than we can vouch for. Every line of code, every configuration, every document — it has to be something we'd accept from someone else.

context.title: We adapt to your context
context.description: Every team and every project is different. We don't apply a fixed recipe — we ask, we listen, and we adjust our approach to fit how you actually work.

propose.title: We propose, not just execute
propose.description: When we see a better path, we bring it up. You're hiring us for our judgment, not just our hands.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.description: Tell us a bit about what you need. We'll get back to you within one business day to schedule a conversation — no sales pitch, just a real discussion of whether we can help.
contact.responseNote: We respond within one business day. No automated replies, no salespeople — someone from the team reads what you send.
contact.successMessage: We received your message about {{interest}}. Someone from the team will read it and get back to you within one business day.
